function smi2_2Dcoords(smi::String)
    mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
    mol = AllChem.AddHs(mol)
    AllChem.Compute2DCoords(mol)
    coordinates = Float32.(np.array(mol.GetConformer().GetPositions()))
    len_atoms = length(mol.GetAtoms())
    @assert len_atoms == size(coordinates, 1) "2D coordinates shape is not align with $smi"
    return coordinates
end

function floyd_warshall(M::Matrix{Int})
    nrows, ncols = size(M)
    @assert nrows == ncols
    n = nrows
    for i in 1:n
        for j in 1:n
            if M[i, j] == 0
                M[i, j] = 510
            end
        end
    end
    for i in 1:n
        M[i, i] = 0
    end
    for k in 1:n
        for i in 1:n
            for j in 1:n
                cost = M[i, k] + M[k, j]
                if M[i, j] > cost
                    M[i, j] = cost
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for i in 1:n
        for j in 1:n
            if M[i, j] >= 510
                M[i, j] = 510
            end
        end
    end
    return M
end

function safe_index(l, e)
    try
        return findfirst(==(e), l) - 1
    catch
        return length(l) - 1
    end
end

function atom_to_feature_vector(atom)
    atom_feature = [
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_atomic_num_list"], atom.GetAtomicNum()),
        findfirst(==(string(atom.GetChiralTag())), allowable_features["possible_chirality_list"]) - 1,
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_degree_list"], atom.GetTotalDegree()),
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_formal_charge_list"], atom.GetFormalCharge()),
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_numH_list"], atom.GetTotalNumHs()),
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_number_radical_e_list"], atom.GetNumRadicalElectrons()),
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_hybridization_list"], string(atom.GetHybridization())),
        findfirst(==(atom.GetIsAromatic()), allowable_features["possible_is_aromatic_list"]) - 1,
        findfirst(==(atom.IsInRing()), allowable_features["possible_is_in_ring_list"]) - 1,
    ]
    return np.array(atom_feature, Int32)
end

function bond_to_feature_vector(bond)
    bond_feature = [
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_bond_type_list"], string(bond.GetBondType())),
        findfirst(==(string(bond.GetStereo())), allowable_features["possible_bond_stereo_list"]) - 1,
        findfirst(==(bond.GetIsConjugated()), allowable_features["possible_is_conjugated_list"]) - 1,
    ]
    return np.array(bond_feature, Int32)
end

function get_graph(mol)
    atom_features_list = [atom_to_feature_vector(atom) for atom in mol.GetAtoms()]
    x = np.array(atom_features_list, Int32)
    num_bond_features = 3
    if length(mol.GetBonds()) > 0
        edges_list = []
        edge_features_list = []
        for bond in mol.GetBonds()
            i = bond.GetBeginAtomIdx() + 1
            j = bond.GetEndAtomIdx() + 1
            edge_feature = bond_to_feature_vector(bond)
            push!(edges_list, (i, j))
            push!(edge_features_list, edge_feature)
            push!(edges_list, (j, i))
            push!(edge_features_list, edge_feature)
        end
        edge_index = np.array(edges_list, dtype=np.int32).T
        edge_attr = np.array(edge_features_list, dtype=np.int32)
    else
        edge_index = np.empty((2, 0), Int32)
        edge_attr = np.empty((0, num_bond_features), Int32)
    end
    return x, edge_index, edge_attr
end

function smi2_graph_features(smiles_string::String)
    mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smiles_string)
    mol = AllChem.AddHs(mol, addCoords=true)
    atoms = [atom.GetSymbol() for atom in mol.GetAtoms() if atom.GetSymbol() != "H"]
    mol = AllChem.RemoveHs(mol)
    x, edge_index, edge_attr = get_graph(mol)
    return Dict(
        "atoms" => atoms,
        "node_attr" => x,
        "edge_index" => edge_index,
        "edge_attr" => edge_attr
    )
end

function single_conf_gen(mol, num_confs=1; seed=42, threads=1, mmff=false, randomize_angles=false, useBasicKnowledge=true, enforceChirality=true, useExpTorsionAnglePrefs=true, useSmallRingTorsions=true, ETKDG=true)
    if ETKDG
        params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
        params.randomSeed = seed
        params.numThreads = threads
        params.useBasicKnowledge = useBasicKnowledge
        params.enforceChirality = enforceChirality
        params.useExpTorsionAnglePrefs = useExpTorsionAnglePrefs
        params.useSmallRingTorsions = useSmallRingTorsions
        if randomize_angles
            params.randomizeConformerAngles = true
        end
        AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mol, numConfs=num_confs, params=params)
    else
        AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mol, numConfs=num_confs, randomSeed=seed, numThreads=threads, useBasicKnowledge=useBasicKnowledge, enforceChirality=enforceChirality, useExpTorsionAnglePrefs=useExpTorsionAnglePrefs, useSmallRingTorsions=useSmallRingTorsions, ETKDG=ETKDG)
    end
    if mmff
        AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(mol, numThreads=threads)
    end
    return mol
end

function kabsch_rotation(P::AbstractMatrix, Q::AbstractMatrix; use_kdtree::Bool=true)
    if use_kdtree && size(P, 2) > 10
        tree = KDTree(P)
        idxs, dists = knn(tree, Q, 1, true)
        matched_P = P[:, [idx[1] for idx in idxs]]
        C = matched_P' * Q
    else
        C = P' * Q
    end
    V, _, W = np.linalg.svd(C)
    d = (det(V) * det(W)) < 0.0
    if d
        V[:, end] .= -V[:, end]
    end
    U = V * W'
    return U
end

function get_optimal_transform(src_atoms, tgt_atoms)
    src_center = mean(src_atoms, dims=2)
    tgt_center = mean(tgt_atoms, dims=2)
    r = kabsch_rotation(src_atoms - src_center, tgt_atoms - tgt_center; use_kdtree=true)
    x = tgt_center - src_center * r
    return r, x
end

function clustering(mol, M=2000, N=10; kmeans=true, removeHs=true, mmff=false, seed=42, threads=1, randomized_angles=false)
    rdkit_coords_list = []
    total_sz = 0
    rdkit_mol = single_conf_gen(mol, num_confs=Int(M / 4), seed=seed, threads=threads)
    if removeHs
        rdkit_mol = Chem.RemoveHs(rdkit_mol)
    end
    sz = length(rdkit_mol.GetConformers())
    tgt_coords = rdkit_mol.GetConformer(0).GetPositions() |> Array{Float32,2}
    tgt_coords = tgt_coords .- mean(tgt_coords, dims=1)
    for i in 1:sz
        _coords = rdkit_mol.GetConformer(i-1).GetPositions() |> Array{Float32,2}
        _coords = _coords .- mean(_coords, dims=1)
        _R, _score = Rotation.align_vectors(_coords, tgt_coords)
        push!(rdkit_coords_list, _coords * _R.as_matrix())
    end
    total_sz += sz
    
    if mmff
        rdkit_mol = single_conf_gen(mol, num_confs=M, mmff=true, seed=seed+1, threads=threads)
        if removeHs
            rdkit_mol = Chem.RemoveHs(rdkit_mol)
        end
        sz = length(rdkit_mol.GetConformers())
        for i in 1:sz
            _coords = rdkit_mol.GetConformer(i-1).GetPositions() |> Array{Float32,2}
            _coords = _coords .- mean(_coords, dims=1)
            _R, _score = Rotation.align_vectors(_coords, tgt_coords)
            push!(rdkit_coords_list, _coords * _R.as_matrix())
        end
        total_sz += sz
    end
    
    if randomized_angles
        rdkit_mol = single_conf_gen(mol, num_confs=Int(M / 4), seed=seed+2, threads=threads, randomize_angles=true)
        if removeHs
            rdkit_mol = Chem.RemoveHs(rdkit_mol)
        end
        sz = length(rdkit_mol.GetConformers())
        for i in 1:sz
            _coords = rdkit_mol.GetConformer(i-1).GetPositions() |> Array{Float32,2}
            _coords = _coords .- mean(_coords, dims=1)
            _R, _score = Rotation.align_vectors(_coords, tgt_coords)
            push!(rdkit_coords_list, _coords * _R.as_matrix())
        end
        total_sz += sz
    end
    
    rdkit_coords_flatten = reshape(reduce(hcat, vec.(rdkit_coords_list)), :, length(rdkit_coords_list))'
    if kmeans
        ids = KMeans(n_clusters=N, random_state=42).fit_predict(rdkit_coords_flatten)
        coords_list = []
        for i in 0:N-1
            idx = findfirst(==(i), ids)
            if idx !== nothing
                push!(coords_list, rdkit_coords_list[idx])
            end
        end
    else
        clust = KMedoids(n_clusters=N, random_state=seed)
        clust.fit(rdkit_coords_flatten)
        idxs = clust.medoid_indices_
        coords_list = [rdkit_coords_list[idx] for idx in idxs]
    end
    return coords_list
end

struct SO3Basis
    spherical_harmonics::Any
    max_l::Int
    function SO3Basis(max_l::Int=3)
        if e3nn_o3 !== nothing
            sh = e3nn_o3.SphericalHarmonics(max_l, true)
            new(sh, max_l)
        else
            new(nothing, max_l)
        end
    end
end

function project(basis::SO3Basis, coords::AbstractMatrix)
    centered = coords .- mean(coords, dims=2)
    r = kabsch_rotation(centered, centered, use_kdtree=true)
    if basis.spherical_harmonics !== nothing
        normalized_coords = centered ./ (norm(centered, dims=2) .+ 1f-8)
        features = basis.spherical_harmonics(py_array(normalized_coords))
        return features, r
    else
        return centered * r, r
    end
end

struct RadialBasis
    layers::Flux.Chain
    sigma::Float32
    function RadialBasis(in_dim::Int=3, out_dim::Int=64, sigma::Float32=0.1f0)
        layers = Flux.Chain(
            Flux.Dense(in_dim, out_dim, x -> exp.(-(x .^ 2) ./ (2 * sigma^2)))
        )
        new(layers, sigma)
    end
end

(rb::RadialBasis)(x) = rb.layers(x)

const HBM_CACHE_LOCK = ReentrantLock()
const HBM_CACHE_POOL = Dict{Int, Vector{Array{Float32}}}()

function get_cached_array(buffer, n_atoms::Int, feature_dim::Int)
    chunk_size = 100
    n_chunks = ceil(Int, n_atoms / chunk_size)
    
    lock(HBM_CACHE_LOCK) do
        if !haskey(HBM_CACHE_POOL, chunk_size)
            HBM_CACHE_POOL[chunk_size] = Vector{Array{Float32}}()
        end
        
        pool = HBM_CACHE_POOL[chunk_size]
        cached_chunks = Vector{Array{Float32}}(undef, n_chunks)
        
        for i in 1:n_chunks
            start_idx = (i-1) * chunk_size + 1
            end_idx = min(i * chunk_size, n_atoms)
            chunk_atoms = end_idx - start_idx + 1
            
            found = false
            for j in length(pool):-1:1
                if size(pool[j], 1) == chunk_atoms && size(pool[j], 2) == feature_dim
                    cached_chunks[i] = pool[j]
                    deleteat!(pool, j)
                    fill!(cached_chunks[i], 0.0f0)
                    found = true
                    break
                end
            end
            
            if !found
                cached_chunks[i] = zeros(Float32, chunk_atoms, feature_dim)
            end
        end
        
        return cached_chunks
    end
end

function generate_filter_pass_csv(failure_csv, filter_json)
    if !isfile(failure_csv)
        data = JSON.parsefile(filter_json)
        names = ["Trajectory_logits_pLDDT", "Trajectory_softmax_pLDDT", "Trajectory_one-hot_pLDDT", "Trajectory_final_pLDDT", "Trajectory_Contacts", "Trajectory_Clashes", "Trajectory_WrongHotspot"]
        special_prefixes = ["Average_", "1_", "2_", "3_", "4_", "5_"]
        tracked_filters = Set{String}()
        for key in keys(data)
            processed_name = key
            for prefix in special_prefixes
                if startswith(key, prefix)
                    processed_name = split(key, "_", limit=2)[2]
                    break
                end
            end
            if occursin("InterfaceAAs", processed_name)
                amino_acids = collect("ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY")
                for aa in amino_acids
                    variant_name = "InterfaceAAs" * aa
                    if !(variant_name in tracked_filters)
                        push!(names, variant_name)
                        push!(tracked_filters, variant_name)
                    end
                end
            elseif !(processed_name in tracked_filters)
                push!(names, processed_name)
                push!(tracked_filters, processed_name)
            end
        end
        df = DataFrame(Dict(name => 0 for name in names))
        CSV.write(failure_csv, df)
    end
end

function update_failures(failure_csv, failure_column_or_dict)
    df = CSV.read(failure_csv, DataFrame)

    function strip_model_prefix(name::String)
        parts = split(name, "_")
        if length(parts) > 0 && length(parts[1]) > 0 && all(isdigit, parts[1])
            return join(parts[2:end], "_")
        end
        return name
    end

    if typeof(failure_column_or_dict) <: Dict
        for (filter_name, count) in pairs(failure_column_or_dict)
            stripped_name = strip_model_prefix(filter_name)
            if stripped_name in names(df)
                df[!, stripped_name] .+= count
            else
                insertcols!(df, length(names(df)) + 1, Symbol(stripped_name) => fill(count, nrow(df)))
            end
        end
    else
        failure_column = strip_model_prefix(failure_column_or_dict)
        if failure_column in names(df)
            df[!, failure_column] .+= 1
        else
            insertcols!(df, length(names(df)) + 1, Symbol(failure_column) => [1])
        end
    end
    CSV.write(failure_csv, df)
end

function check_accepted_designs(design_paths, mpnn_csv, final_labels, final_csv, advanced_settings, target_settings, design_labels)
    accepted_binders = filter(f -> endswith(f, ".pdb") && !startswith(f, "."), readdir(design_paths["Accepted"], join=true))
    if length(accepted_binders) >= target_settings["number_of_final_designs"]
        println("Target number $(length(accepted_binders)) of designs reached! Reranking...")
        ranked_dir = design_paths["Accepted/Ranked"]
        for file in readdir(ranked_dir)
            rm(joinpath(ranked_dir, file), force=true)
        end
        design_df = CSV.read(mpnn_csv, DataFrame)
        sort!(design_df, :Average_i_pTM, rev=true)
        final_df = DataFrame([Symbol(label) => Any[] for label in final_labels])
        rank = 1
        for row in eachrow(design_df)
            for binder in accepted_binders
                binder_name = splitext(basename(binder))[1]
                if occursin("_model", binder_name)
                    parts = split(binder_name, "model", limit=2)
                    target_binder_name = parts[1]
                    model = parts[2]
                    if target_binder_name == row.Design
                        row_data = [rank; collect(row)]
                        push!(final_df, row_data)
                        old_path = binder
                        new_name = "$(rank)_$(target_binder_name)_model$(model).pdb"
                        new_path = joinpath(ranked_dir, new_name)
                        cp(old_path, new_path)
                        rank += 1
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        CSV.write(final_csv, final_df)
        if get(advanced_settings, "zip_animations", false)
            zip_and_empty_folder(design_paths["Trajectory/Animation"], ".html")
        end
        if get(advanced_settings, "zip_plots", false)
            zip_and_empty_folder(design_paths["Trajectory/Plots"], ".png")
        end
        return true
    else
        return false
    end
end

function validate_design_sequence(sequence, num_clashes, advanced_settings)
    note_array = String[]
    if num_clashes > 0
        push!(note_array, "Relaxed structure contains clashes.")
    end
    if haskey(advanced_settings, "omit_AAs") && advanced_settings["omit_AAs"] !== nothing
        restricted_AAs = strip.(split(advanced_settings["omit_AAs"], ","))
        for restricted_AA in restricted_AAs
            if occursin(restricted_AA, sequence)
                push!(note_array, "Contains: $restricted_AA!")
            end
        end
    end
    analysis = ProteinAnalysis(sequence)
    extinction_coefficient_reduced, _ = analysis.molar_extinction_coefficient()
    molecular_weight = round(analysis.molecular_weight() / 1000, digits=2)
    extinction_coefficient_reduced_1 = round(extinction_coefficient_reduced / molecular_weight * 0.01, digits=2)
    if extinction_coefficient_reduced_1 <= 2
        push!(note_array, "Absorption value is $extinction_coefficient_reduced_1, consider adding tryptophane to design.")
    end
    notes = join(note_array, " ")
    return notes
end

function target_pdb_rmsd(trajectory_pdb, starting_pdb, chain_ids_string)
    parser = BioPDB.PDBParser(QUIET=true)
    structure_trajectory = parser.get_structure("trajectory", trajectory_pdb)
    structure_starting = parser.get_structure("starting", starting_pdb)
    chain_trajectory = structure_trajectory[0]["A"]
    chain_ids = strip.(split(chain_ids_string, ","))
    residues_starting = []
    for chain_id in chain_ids
        chain = structure_starting[0][chain_id]
        for residue in chain
            if BioPDB.Polypeptide.is_aa(residue, standard=true)
                push!(residues_starting, residue)
            end
        end
    end
    residues_trajectory = [residue for residue in chain_trajectory if BioPDB.Polypeptide.is_aa(residue, standard=true)]
    min_length = min(length(residues_starting), length(residues_trajectory))
    residues_starting = residues_starting[1:min_length]
    residues_trajectory = residues_trajectory[1:min_length]
    atoms_starting = [residue["CA"] for residue in residues_starting if haskey(residue, "CA")]
    atoms_trajectory = [residue["CA"] for residue in residues_trajectory if haskey(residue, "CA")]
    sup = BioPDB.Superimposer()
    sup.set_atoms(atoms_starting, atoms_trajectory)
    rmsd = sup.rms
    return round(Float64(rmsd), digits=2)
end

function smi2_2Dcoords(smi::String)
    mol = Chem.MolFromSmiles(smi)
    mol = AllChem.AddHs(mol)
    AllChem.Compute2DCoords(mol)
    coordinates = Float32.(np.array(mol.GetConformer().GetPositions()))
    len_atoms = length(mol.GetAtoms())
    @assert len_atoms == size(coordinates, 1) "2D coordinates shape is not align with $smi"
    return coordinates
end

function floyd_warshall(M::Matrix{Int})
    nrows, ncols = size(M)
    @assert nrows == ncols
    n = nrows
    for i in 1:n
        for j in 1:n
            if M[i, j] == 0
                M[i, j] = 510
            end
        end
    end
    for i in 1:n
        M[i, i] = 0
    end
    for k in 1:n
        for i in 1:n
            for j in 1:n
                cost = M[i, k] + M[k, j]
                if M[i, j] > cost
                    M[i, j] = cost
                end
            end
        end
    end
    for i in 1:n
        for j in 1:n
            if M[i, j] >= 510
                M[i, j] = 510
            end
        end
    end
    return M
end

function safe_index(l, e)
    try
        return findfirst(==(e), l) - 1
    catch
        return length(l) - 1
    end
end

function atom_to_feature_vector(atom)
    atom_feature = [
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_atomic_num_list"], atom.GetAtomicNum()),
        findfirst(==(string(atom.GetChiralTag())), allowable_features["possible_chirality_list"]) - 1,
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_degree_list"], atom.GetTotalDegree()),
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_formal_charge_list"], atom.GetFormalCharge()),
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_numH_list"], atom.GetTotalNumHs()),
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_number_radical_e_list"], atom.GetNumRadicalElectrons()),
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_hybridization_list"], string(atom.GetHybridization())),
        findfirst(==(atom.GetIsAromatic()), allowable_features["possible_is_aromatic_list"]) - 1,
        findfirst(==(atom.IsInRing()), allowable_features["possible_is_in_ring_list"]) - 1,
    ]
    return np.array(atom_feature, Int32)
end

function bond_to_feature_vector(bond)
    bond_feature = [
        safe_index(allowable_features["possible_bond_type_list"], string(bond.GetBondType())),
        findfirst(==(string(bond.GetStereo())), allowable_features["possible_bond_stereo_list"]) - 1,
        findfirst(==(bond.GetIsConjugated()), allowable_features["possible_is_conjugated_list"]) - 1,

    return np.array(bond_feature, Int32)

function get_graph(mol)
    atom_features_list = [atom_to_feature_vector(atom) for atom in mol.GetAtoms()]
    x = np.array(atom_features_list, Int32)
    num_bond_features = 3
    if length(mol.GetBonds()) > 0
        edges_list = []
        edge_features_list = []
        for bond in mol.GetBonds()
            i = bond.GetBeginAtomIdx() + 1
            j = bond.GetEndAtomIdx() + 1
            edge_feature = bond_to_feature_vector(bond)
            push!(edges_list, (i, j))
            push!(edge_features_list, edge_feature)
            push!(edges_list, (j, i))
            push!(edge_features_list, edge_feature)
        end
        edge_index = np.array(edges_list, dtype=np.int32).T
        edge_attr = np.array(edge_features_list, dtype=np.int32)
    else
        edge_index = np.empty((2, 0), Int32)
        edge_attr = np.empty((0, num_bond_features), Int32)
    end
    return x, edge_index, edge_attr
end

function single_conf_gen(mol, num_confs=1; seed=42, threads=1, mmff=false, randomize_angles=false, useBasicKnowledge=true, enforceChirality=true, useExpTorsionAnglePrefs=true, useSmallRingTorsions=true, ETKDG=true)
    if ETKDG
        params = AllChem.ETKDGv3()
        params.randomSeed = seed
        params.numThreads = threads
        params.useBasicKnowledge = useBasicKnowledge
        params.enforceChirality = enforceChirality
        params.useExpTorsionAnglePrefs = useExpTorsionAnglePrefs
        params.useSmallRingTorsions = useSmallRingTorsions
        if randomize_angles
            params.randomizeConformerAngles = true
        end
        AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mol, numConfs=num_confs, params=params)
    else
        AllChem.EmbedMultipleConfs(mol, numConfs=num_confs, randomSeed=seed, numThreads=threads, useBasicKnowledge=useBasicKnowledge, enforceChirality=enforceChirality, useExpTorsionAnglePrefs=useExpTorsionAnglePrefs, useSmallRingTorsions=useSmallRingTorsions, ETKDG=ETKDG)
    end
    if mmff
        AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMoleculeConfs(mol, numThreads=threads)
    end
    return mol
end

function kabsch_rotation(P::AbstractMatrix, Q::AbstractMatrix; use_kdtree::Bool=true)
    if use_kdtree && size(P, 2) > 10
        tree = KDTree(P)
        idxs, dists = knn(tree, Q, 1, true)
        matched_P = P[:, [idx[1] for idx in idxs]]
        C = matched_P' * Q
    else
        C = P' * Q
    end
    V, _, W = np.linalg.svd(C)
    d = (det(V) * det(W)) < 0.0
    if d
        V[:, end] .= -V[:, end]
    end
    U = V * W'
    return U
end

function get_optimal_transform(src_atoms, tgt_atoms)
    src_center = mean(src_atoms, dims=2)
    tgt_center = mean(tgt_atoms, dims=2)
    r = kabsch_rotation(src_atoms - src_center, tgt_atoms - tgt_center; use_kdtree=true)
    x = tgt_center - src_center * r
    return r, x
end

function clustering(mol, M=2000, N=10; kmeans=true, removeHs=true, mmff=false, seed=42, threads=1, randomized_angles=false)
    rdkit_coords_list = []
    total_sz = 0
    rdkit_mol = single_conf_gen(mol, num_confs=Int(M / 4), seed=seed, threads=threads)
    if removeHs
        rdkit_mol = Chem.RemoveHs(rdkit_mol)
    end
    sz = length(rdkit_mol.GetConformers())
    tgt_coords = rdkit_mol.GetConformer(0).GetPositions() |> Array{Float32,2}
    tgt_coords = tgt_coords .- mean(tgt_coords, dims=1)
    for i in 1:sz
        _coords = rdkit_mol.GetConformer(i-1).GetPositions() |> Array{Float32,2}
        _coords = _coords .- mean(_coords, dims=1)
        _R, _score = Rotation.align_vectors(_coords, tgt_coords)
        push!(rdkit_coords_list, _coords * _R.as_matrix())
    end
    total_sz += sz
    
    if mmff
        rdkit_mol = single_conf_gen(mol, num_confs=M, mmff=true, seed=seed+1, threads=threads)
        if removeHs
            rdkit_mol = Chem.RemoveHs(rdkit_mol)
        end
        sz = length(rdkit_mol.GetConformers())
        for i in 1:sz
            _coords = rdkit_mol.GetConformer(i-1).GetPositions() |> Array{Float32,2}
            _coords = _coords .- mean(_coords, dims=1)
            _R, _score = Rotation.align_vectors(_coords, tgt_coords)
            push!(rdkit_coords_list, _coords * _R.as_matrix())
        end
        total_sz += sz
    end
    
    if randomized_angles
        rdkit_mol = single_conf_gen(mol, num_confs=Int(M / 4), seed=seed+2, threads=threads, randomize_angles=true)
        if removeHs
            rdkit_mol = Chem.RemoveHs(rdkit_mol)
        end
        sz = length(rdkit_mol.GetConformers())
        for i in 1:sz
            _coords = rdkit_mol.GetConformer(i-1).GetPositions() |> Array{Float32,2}
            _coords = _coords .- mean(_coords, dims=1)
            _R, _score = Rotation.align_vectors(_coords, tgt_coords)
            push!(rdkit_coords_list, _coords * _R.as_matrix())
        end
        total_sz += sz
    end
    
    rdkit_coords_flatten = reshape(reduce(hcat, vec.(rdkit_coords_list)), :, length(rdkit_coords_list))'
    if kmeans
        ids = KMeans(n_clusters=N, random_state=42).fit_predict(rdkit_coords_flatten)
        coords_list = []
        for i in 0:N-1
            idx = findfirst(==(i), ids)
            if idx !== nothing
                push!(coords_list, rdkit_coords_list[idx])
            end
        end
    else
        clust = KMedoids(n_clusters=N, random_state=seed)
        clust.fit(rdkit_coords_flatten)
        idxs = clust.medoid_indices_
        coords_list = [rdkit_coords_list[idx] for idx in idxs]
    end
    return coords_list
end

struct SO3Basis
    spherical_harmonics::Any
    max_l::Int
    function SO3Basis(max_l::Int=3)
        if e3nn_o3 !== nothing
            sh = e3nn_o3.SphericalHarmonics(max_l, true)
            new(sh, max_l)
        else
            new(nothing, max_l)
        end
    end
end

function project(basis::SO3Basis, coords::AbstractMatrix)
    centered = coords .- mean(coords, dims=2)
    r = kabsch_rotation(centered, centered, use_kdtree=true)
    if basis.spherical_harmonics !== nothing
        normalized_coords = centered ./ (norm(centered, dims=2) .+ 1f-8)
        features = basis.spherical_harmonics(py_array(normalized_coords))
        return features, r
    else
        return centered * r, r
    end
end

struct RadialBasis
    layers::Flux.Chain
    sigma::Float32
    function RadialBasis(in_dim::Int=3, out_dim::Int=64, sigma::Float32=0.1f0)
        layers = Flux.Chain(
            Flux.Dense(in_dim, out_dim, x -> exp.(-(x .^ 2) ./ (2 * sigma^2)))
        )
        new(layers, sigma)
    end
end

(rb::RadialBasis)(x) = rb.layers(x)

const HBM_CACHE_LOCK = ReentrantLock()
const HBM_CACHE_POOL = Dict{Int, Vector{Array{Float32}}}()

function get_cached_array(buffer, n_atoms::Int, feature_dim::Int)
    chunk_size = 100
    n_chunks = ceil(Int, n_atoms / chunk_size)
    
    lock(HBM_CACHE_LOCK) do
        if !haskey(HBM_CACHE_POOL, chunk_size)
            HBM_CACHE_POOL[chunk_size] = Vector{Array{Float32}}()
        end
        
        pool = HBM_CACHE_POOL[chunk_size]
        cached_chunks = Vector{Array{Float32}}(undef, n_chunks)
        
        for i in 1:n_chunks
            start_idx = (i-1) * chunk_size + 1
            end_idx = min(i * chunk_size, n_atoms)
            chunk_atoms = end_idx - start_idx + 1
            
            found = false
            for j in length(pool):-1:1
                if size(pool[j], 1) == chunk_atoms && size(pool[j], 2) == feature_dim
                    cached_chunks[i] = pool[j]
                    deleteat!(pool, j)
                    fill!(cached_chunks[i], 0.0f0)
                    found = true
                    break
                end
            end
            
            if !found
                cached_chunks[i] = zeros(Float32, chunk_atoms, feature_dim)
            end
        end
        
        return cached_chunks
    end
end

function update_failures(failure_csv, failure_column_or_dict)
    df = CSV.read(failure_csv, DataFrame)

    function strip_model_prefix(name::String)
        parts = split(name, "_")
        if length(parts) > 0 && length(parts[1]) > 0 && all(isdigit, parts[1])
            return join(parts[2:end], "_")
        end
        return name
    end

    if typeof(failure_column_or_dict) <: Dict
        for (filter_name, count) in pairs(failure_column_or_dict)
            stripped_name = strip_model_prefix(filter_name)
            if stripped_name in names(df)
                df[!, stripped_name] .+= count
            else
                insertcols!(df, length(names(df)) + 1, Symbol(stripped_name) => fill(count, nrow(df)))
            end
        end
    else
        failure_column = strip_model_prefix(failure_column_or_dict)
        if failure_column in names(df)
            df[!, failure_column] .+= 1
        else
            insertcols!(df, length(names(df)) + 1, Symbol(failure_column) => [1])
        end
    end
    CSV.write(failure_csv, df)
end

function validate_design_sequence(sequence, num_clashes, advanced_settings)

        restricted_AAs = strip.(split(advanced_settings["omit_AAs"], ","))
        for restricted_AA in restricted_AAs
            if occursin(restricted_AA, sequence)
                push!(note_array, "Contains: $restricted_AA!")
            end
        end
    end
    analysis = ProteinAnalysis(sequence)
    extinction_coefficient_reduced, _ = analysis.molar_extinction_coefficient()
    molecular_weight = round(analysis.molecular_weight() / 1000, digits=2)
    extinction_coefficient_reduced_1 = round(extinction_coefficient_reduced / molecular_weight * 0.01, digits=2)
    if extinction_coefficient_reduced_1 <= 2
        push!(note_array, "Absorption value is $extinction_coefficient_reduced_1, consider adding tryptophane to design.")
    end
    notes = join(note_array, " ")
    return notes
end

    residues_starting = []
    for chain_id in chain_ids
        chain = structure_starting[0][chain_id]
        for residue in chain
            if BioPDB.Polypeptide.is_aa(residue, standard=true)
                push!(residues_starting, residue)
            end
        end
    end
    residues_trajectory = [residue for residue in chain_trajectory if BioPDB.Polypeptide.is_aa(residue, standard=true)]
    min_length = min(length(residues_starting), length(residues_trajectory))
    residues_starting = residues_starting[1:min_length]
    residues_trajectory = residues_trajectory[1:min_length]
    atoms_starting = [residue["CA"] for residue in residues_starting if haskey(residue, "CA")]
    atoms_trajectory = [residue["CA"] for residue in residues_trajectory if haskey(residue, "CA")]
    sup = BioPDB.Superimposer()
    sup.set_atoms(atoms_starting, atoms_trajectory)
    rmsd = sup.rms
    return round(Float64(rmsd), digits=2)
end
